items.quote: I just want to go away for a few days even by myself and chill and shut some of this out.
items.label: wants a few days away

items.quote: I just need to know I'm doing the right thing and hopefully one day I can put this behind me
items.label: needs to know she is doing right

items.quote: I am contacting yet another avenue to help me with all of the legal aspects of managing what I have been trying to do for years.
items.label: get legal help with managing affairs

items.quote: contracts falling through with the selling of the house and disappointment after disappointment.
items.label: house sale contracts keep falling through

items.quote: the financial dept where she is a resident had me signing documents to apply for medicaid right now, this minute because the house hasn't sold as quick as I thought it would
items.label: rushed to sign Medicaid papers at facility

items.quote: The hard part is her neediness. She’s constantly asking for the same things and states the same worries.
items.label: mother's constant neediness and repeated worries

items.quote: I just wished we had an emotional bond so I can care for her out of love.
items.label: wants to care out of love

items.quote: Right now I’m resentful and really don’t understand why I can’t get over it and just be there for her the way a daughter should be.
items.label: resentment while caring for mother

items.quote: For my own mental and physical health, I needed to find ways to take a break regularly from caregiving
items.label: regular breaks for own health

items.quote: So far I haven't even found a nursing home with physical therapy options that will accept her having medicare, all are refusing her.
items.label: no nursing home accepts Medicare for rehab

items.quote: I can't get the hospital to tell me a straight answer.
items.label: hospital gives no straight answers

items.quote: I am sleep-deprived, have no one to ask, and am honestly in full despair.
items.label: sleep-deprived with no one to ask

items.quote: Are there nurse options for when I need to go to a doctor's appointment myself
items.label: backup care for own appointments

items.quote: I have become my mom's assistant, scheduler, IT tech, and overall house/car maintenance provider.
items.label: became mother's all-purpose helper

items.quote: I have an older brother who lives 3 hours away and is present only enough to tell me
items.label: brother far away and not helping

items.quote: balancing that with getting the decisions made to move her to where she will eventually end up anyway.
items.label: get mother moved to assisted living

items.quote: I am struggling in giving her the respect of seeing her future home
items.label: respect her wishes while deciding move

items.quote: I need to remind myself that it's for a better and safer quality of life for her.
items.label: wants better and safer life for mother

items.quote: When I broke down and begged them to help me, younger sister told me, "We all make our choices."
items.label: sisters refuse to help

items.quote: I am so tired of dealing with this for over 4 years since Mom's stroke.
items.label: exhausted after four years of care

items.quote: I wish I had the courage to stop caregiving
items.label: wants courage to stop caregiving

items.quote: I get so angry and hurt, even therapy didn’t help.
items.label: anger and hurt even with therapy

items.quote: We are looking for a place where we can benefit from the experiences of others who've already gone further down this road.
items.label: find a place to learn from others

items.quote: The biggest issue of late is that he is telling stories about his past that seem impossible to be true, and my mom does not know what to believe.
items.label: father's impossible stories upset mother

items.quote: My sister and I are praying for direction on how to help both of them!
items.label: wants to help both parents

items.quote: I'm starting to realize what a disadvantage we've been at, having had so little information.
items.label: little information about the illness

items.quote: Its hard to get her back in the car to take her back to the facility.
items.label: hard to take her back to facility

items.quote: We have tried many times to take her to lunch, shopping etc. but it always ends with her request to be taken "home" to see her dogs.
items.label: outings end with pleas to go home

items.quote: We don't know whether the anger is possibly caused by the newly added medication or if its just the realization of having to accept her new living arrangements or if it is just part of the disease.
items.label: unsure why she is angry

items.quote: We didn't want her to feel "stuck" at the facility
items.label: does not want her to feel stuck

items.quote: now as holidays approach we are trying to find advice on what's best for her and for us.
items.label: plan holiday that works for her and family

items.quote: It is so hard to know if we are doing the right thing.
items.label: unsure if doing the right thing

items.quote: struggle with sisters who live near us but don’t help even after I have asked.
items.label: sisters nearby will not help

items.quote: One told me “We all make our choices” last time I broke down begging and hasn’t talked to Mom or me in 2 months.
items.label: sister refused help and went silent

items.quote: I know I need to stop letting my sisters excluding me from any activities bother me
items.label: stop sisters' exclusion bothering her

items.quote: I need to find a support group to meet with.
items.label: find a support group

items.quote: I text her desperate for an hour or two break.
items.label: get an hour or two of relief

items.quote: I provide 24/7 care for him by myself.
items.label: 24/7 care alone

items.quote: my siblings and I are trying to figure out how to set up a new finance management system that allows for her to be in the driver’s seat while also allowing for us to step in and help her out as needed.
items.label: set up finance system mom controls

items.quote: where I’m stuck is how my siblings and I can also get some level of access (even if it’s just read-only) without taking on the credit exposure and liability of becoming authorized users.
items.label: read access without liability

items.quote: I would like to be able to help her with this remotely, without having jump through a million hoops.
items.label: help mom with accounts remotely

items.quote: This was a multi step process and every institution wanted separate forms.
items.label: every institution wanted separate forms

items.quote: Of course I also kept loads of documentation of everything I did so no one could accuse me of any malfeasance.
items.label: avoid accusations of wrongdoing

items.quote: I am the sole caregiver. I get no help.
items.label: sole caregiver with no help

items.quote: She has not been to one doctors appointment. I take care of all of that.
items.label: handles all doctor appointments alone

items.quote: He is very sick and can’t even go visit his family because we have no money.
items.label: no money for father to visit family

items.quote: I am not done when I get justice for my father I am taking this all the way to the Supreme Court if I must.
items.label: get justice for father

items.quote: This cannot happen to another family.
items.label: stop this happening to other families

items.quote: I’m POA to my elderly mother who lives out of state and I have been dealing with missing information from people close to her who live in her town which is causing me a great deal of stress
items.label: POA from far away with missing information

items.quote: I’m too exhausted to even go into the IRA right now as shes on Medicaid.
items.label: too exhausted to handle inherited IRA

items.quote: How can I convince second POA to bounce to first so I can go to second?
items.label: swap roles with second POA

items.quote: I need a break as it’s affecting my physical and mental health.
items.label: needs a break for health

items.quote: Basically everything is in disarray due to the distance and communication problems and lack of communication from people close to her.
items.label: everything in disarray from distance

items.quote: She is getting a little demanding.
items.label: mother getting demanding

items.quote: I haven't been visiting her as much and to be honest I just haven't wanted to.
items.label: not wanting to visit

items.quote: I've been in a pretty bad funk for awhile now. Trying to sell the house, etc.
items.label: bad funk while selling the house

items.quote: I'm just struggling with the big decisions on the outside.
items.label: struggling with big outside decisions

items.quote: Maybe if I schedule visits and stick with that, it would help.
items.label: schedule visits to cope

items.quote: I am having such a difficult time not being angry at my Mom when I logically understand it's not her fault.
items.label: angry at mom despite knowing the disease

items.quote: This has shoved me right off that tight rope and I can not cope.
items.label: caregiving broke mental health balance

items.quote: What about my husband and my teenager who need me but only get a shell of me now?
items.label: husband and teen get only a shell

items.quote: How do you not end up hating the person and instead just hate this miserable disease?
items.label: not hate mom, only the disease

items.quote: I have no life.
items.label: has no life of her own

items.quote: I live out of state so my brother went… no help to me.
items.label: out of state, brother gave no help

items.quote: I never saw any paperwork of a diagnosis.
items.label: never saw diagnosis paperwork

items.quote: My sister and I wonder about whether or not she needs to know, as it will upset her.
items.label: unsure whether to tell mom diagnosis

items.quote: Part of the issue is planning for the future is hard when she doesn’t see the need for our help.
items.label: mom sees no need for help

items.quote: About every other day some of the pills wind up on the floor.
items.label: pills end up on floor

items.quote: She has a hard time getting really small pills out of the cups and her manual dexterity sometimes just knocks the cups over.
items.label: hard to get small pills out of cups

items.quote: But, me and her really don't want to do that all the time.
items.label: avoid hand-feeding pills

items.quote: I do stay and watch that each set of pills make it into his mouth AND that they stay there
items.label: make sure pills are actually taken

items.quote: I can no longer leave them out or beside his chair to take. He will forget or knock them over.
items.label: he forgets or knocks over pills

items.quote: I was going to call about getting her into a nursing home but kept stalling and lately just hiding in my room most of the day
items.label: stalling on placing mom, hiding in room

items.quote: I have been ambivalent, angry, frustrated and just plain depressed.
items.label: ambivalent, angry and depressed

items.quote: she had fallen and I didnt know when.
items.label: mom fell and he did not know when

items.quote: Its like pulling teeth even at home to get her to eat once a day.
items.label: hard to get mom to eat

items.quote: I certainly didn't and dont want her to suffer.
items.label: does not want mother to suffer

items.quote: His diagnosis was missed by several doctors and with HIPPA, if it was caught, no one knew so we could start getting help sooner.
items.label: missed diagnosis delayed help

items.quote: In our state there are not may facilities that offer help to those patients with aggression caused by the dementia
items.label: few facilities for dementia aggression

items.quote: he bounced in and out of ER rooms, hospital stays and in his final days, an adult psychiatric ward.
items.label: bounced between ER, hospital and psych ward

items.quote: I hope that he knew that he was indeed loved, even if the last few years seemed hard and distant from everyone.
items.label: wants father to know he was loved

items.quote: We missed out on so much time because we didn't know.
items.label: missed time by not knowing

items.quote: Who is the best person to help me with his financials and what I can do with them to provide a stream of income, so I can see what he can afford and for how long?
items.label: plan dad's finances for assisted living

items.quote: I, along with his doctor, believe he should not be living alone and should be somewhere with social interaction, good food and stuff to do.
items.label: get dad out of living alone

items.quote: I have a girl come in 2x per week for a couple hours each time, but that is not enough.
items.label: in-home help is not enough

items.quote: I am an only child, all this falls on me
items.label: only child, everything falls on her

items.quote: My sister who is very jealous of me an hates me told me one day not to come to see my mom anymore that she had POA.
items.label: sister with POA bars visits

items.quote: What can I do to see her
items.label: be able to visit mother

items.quote: My brother had medical & financial POA & told the nursing home there was a no contact order against me so I couldn’t visit her.
items.label: brother with POA blocked visits

items.quote: Increasingly, he has no interest in doing anything together.
items.label: husband no longer wants to do things together

items.quote: Are these behaviors associated with the cognitive changes? Or is this just a midlife crisis?
items.label: understand cause of withdrawal

items.quote: I have not gone anywhere except Drs appts. and the market.
items.label: has not gone anywhere in 8 years

items.quote: I could USE some Help.
items.label: get some help

items.quote: It took 3 weeks and 6 plus phone calls to get a return call regarding friendly visitors program.
items.label: weeks of calls to get a callback

items.quote: the volunteer who was to call my Mother never called.
items.label: volunteer never called mother

items.quote: Looking for a pill box or dispenser that will sense if it's been picked up or opened or similar, and alert a caregiver if it has not.
items.label: pillbox that alerts if not opened

items.quote: Dad will definitely take them once he remembers to pick up the pillbox.
items.label: dad forgets to pick up pillbox

items.quote: he was occasionally leaving it on and burning pans
items.label: dad left stove on and burned pans

items.quote: trying to improve our odds on the most severe safety risks in the meantime.
items.label: reduce worst safety risks for now

items.quote: Sticker shock when emergencies all of a sudden require more care after rehab or when Medicare completes payments for care
items.label: sticker shock when care needs jump

items.quote: Tips for the lone 24/7 Caregiver who does not have any breaks or days off, and no one to ask - or who is willing to fill in.
items.label: no breaks and no one to fill in

items.quote: I would like to find or start a group for adult children in the evening or weekend.
items.label: find evening or weekend support group

items.quote: I have been looking for a support group, but they are all during the day geared toward retired care gives.
items.label: support groups only meet in the daytime

items.quote: my siblings and I are doing our best to try to do what is best for him.
items.label: wants to do what is best for dad

items.quote: my wife and I are planning to have my mother move in with us so we can better support her ongoing care needs.
items.label: wants to better support mother's care

items.quote: Selling her current home would help provide much-needed financial resources for her medical expenses and long-term care.
items.label: sell mother's house to fund care

items.quote: Between her medical expenses and the significant costs of caregiving, our financial resources are already stretched thin.
items.label: finances stretched thin by care costs

items.quote: the house needs several repairs before we can put it on the market, including interior painting, ceiling and window frame repairs from previous water leaks, and basement mold remediation.
items.label: house needs repairs before sale

items.quote: I'm hoping to learn whether anyone knows of nonprofit organizations, community programs, affordable contractors, or other resources that might offer free or reduced-cost assistance with these repairs.
items.label: find low-cost help with repairs

items.quote: My mom has recently become wheelchair bound and keeps attempting to stand or walk and falls.
items.label: mom tries to stand and falls

items.quote: Does anyone have suggestions on how to help keep her in the wheelchair?
items.label: keep mom in the wheelchair
